newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FOREKSPANK H1 PROFIT 50.4 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: FOREKSPANK H1 PROFIT 50.4 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Forekspank's net profit for June was 7.7 million kroons and the bank's first-half profit was 50.4 millions or 70 percent of the profit forecast for 1997, the bank said on Monday.
The bank's balance sheet volume increased by 892 million kroons or by 89 percent from the beginning of the year.
Income for the bank increased by 97.1 percent compared to the same period in the previous year to reach 122.9 million kroons.
Of the bank's income, 29.3 percent was from net interest income, 26.6 percent from foreign exchange trading, 26.1 percent from commissions and 17.4 percent from investments.
Costs rose to 58.2 million kroons, 19.3 million kroons higher than the previous year.
Personnel costs claimed 35.2 percent of the total, adminstrative costs grabbed 34.1 percent, paid commissions 12.4 percent and depreciation was 11.1 percent of the total.
